scope: MAF correction; LD heterogeneity is the separate problem motivating GREML-LDMS.
span: We have shown by theoretical derivation (Supplementary Note) that GREML-SC estimates of h2 are biased if causal variants have a different MAF spectrum from the variants used in analysis.
